quests.start: Starts at Penacony, Penacony Grand Theater; requirement: Obtain all parts of Hanu's Adventure.

quests.title: Loothunt in Mazeville
quests.summary: The Family invites you to join an investigation at the theater.
quests.start: Starts at Penacony, Penacony Grand Theater, after Trailblaze Mission And on the Eighth Day.

quests.title: Scorchsand Vacation
quests.summary: Aideen prepared a custom gift for you, but an accident got in the way.
quests.start: Starts at Penacony, SoulGlad™ Scorchsand Audition Venue, after Trailblaze Mission And on the Eighth Day.

quests.title: Checking Out
quests.summary: Himeko reports the Express crew now owns a small share of the Penacony Conglomerate, so you visit The Reverie.
quests.start: Starts at Penacony, The Reverie (Reality), after Trailblaze Mission Stranger in a Strange Land.

quests.title: Cloud-Bound Hearts
quests.summary: The Family's secretary wants to discuss the transfer of the Radiant Feldspar's ownership with you.
quests.start: Starts at Penacony, The Radiant Feldspar, after Trailblaze Mission Stranger in a Strange Land.

quests.title: Amphoreus Annals
quests.summary: Short stories from the people of Amphoreus, starting with a dispute at Okhema's busy marketplace.
quests.start: Starts at Amphoreus, "Eternal Holy City" Okhema, after Trailblaze Mission Silver Chariot, Away to that Blackened Land.

parts.title: Love in the Time of Black Tide
The Girl, the Coins, and Homeland
Where Stone and Wind Stood Still

quests.title: Chirping Secret
quests.summary: A golden-thread mannequin that looks like it came from Penacony has caught your eye in Okhema.
quests.start: Starts at Amphoreus, "Eternal Holy City" Okhema.

quests.title: Disquieting Dream
quests.summary: Prophecy takes a new form in Amphoreus, tied to Pasithea's dreams and the Titan Oronyx.
quests.start: Starts at Amphoreus, "Eternal Holy City" Okhema, after Trailblaze Mission Hero, Bear Thy Coreflame.

quests.title: Golden Scapegoat
quests.summary: The Golden Scapegoat is an Amphoreus relic that defies common sense; try to unravel its secret.
quests.start: Starts at Amphoreus, "Eternal Holy City" Okhema; requirement: Complete a Golden Scapegoat puzzle.

quests.title: I Once Was In Arcadia
quests.summary: The Strife Titan has fallen, but trouble outside Okhema's gates shows the war is not over.
quests.start: Starts at Amphoreus, "Eternal Holy City" Okhema, after Trailblaze Mission Hero, Bear Thy Coreflame.

quests.title: Whereto Shall We Go
quests.summary: Aglaea reports a disturbance in the Dromas Workshop at a delicate moment for the holy city.
quests.start: Starts at Amphoreus, "Eternal Holy City" Okhema, after Trailblaze Mission Hero, Bear Thy Coreflame.

quests.title: Janus' Maze
quests.summary: The Janus' Maze you solved in memory was more than a door lock; search the area for what it hides.
quests.start: Starts at Amphoreus, "Sanctum of Prophecy" Janusopolis, after Trailblaze Mission Passage, Reveal the Past Once More.

quests.title: Chirping Secret Treasure?
quests.summary: A path once blocked by an iron ball in Styxia may now be open.
quests.start: Starts at Amphoreus, "Dragonbone City" Styxia, after Trailblaze Mission Scholar, Let Us Meet Again Before the Gates of Truth.

quests.title: Gold Specimen Goat
quests.summary: Someone on the Council of Elders has taken an interest in the Golden Scapegoat's secrets.
quests.start: Starts at Amphoreus, "Demigod Council" Dawncloud.

quests.summary: A night-time commotion near the Marmoreal Market suggests someone is in danger.
quests.start: Starts at Amphoreus, "Fallen Twilight City" Okhema, after Trailblaze Mission Dawn, Shine at the World's End.

quests.title: Grieving Embers
quests.summary: With Okhema's long dawn over and the black tide rising, refugees gather in the Dawncloud Temple.
quests.start: Starts at Amphoreus, "Lightless Chapel" Dawncloud, after Trailblaze Mission Dawn, Shine at the World's End.

quests.title: Resplendent Ambrosia
quests.summary: Parts of the Vortex of Genesis begin to float; check on the basin that has been giving you gifts.

quests.summary: Cyrene has lost something important and asks for your help.

quests.summary: The Spirithief Bartholos wants to brag about saving the Grove's critters, and has a favor to ask.

quests.title: As I've Written
quests.summary: Cyrene has been out of sight since the Irontomb battle; you find her somewhere unexpected.
quests.start: Starts at Amphoreus, Beyond Time: An Eternal Page.

quests.title: Arcadia Panorama
quests.summary: Short Planarcadia stories, starting with a slightly sketchy request from Sampo.

quests.start: Starts at Planarcadia, Delusional Theater: Hospital Room.

quests.title: Duomensional Walk
quests.summary: Locals in Duomension City help visitors make sense of the Interplanar Jump transit route.
quests.start: Starts at Planarcadia, Duomension City, after Trailblaze Mission The Indifference of Those Who Yet Live.

quests.start: Starts at Planarcadia, Duomension City, after Trailblaze Mission The Indifference of Those Who Yet Live.

quests.title: The Comic With No Answers
quests.summary: A small comic convention opens in the city center, and you drop in with time to spare.
quests.start: Starts at Planarcadia, Duomension City, after Trailblaze Mission The Indifference of Those Who Yet Live.

quests.title: Thirty First Dates
quests.summary: A headless mechatron parked by the road leads to a man claiming his girlfriend is hunting him.
quests.start: Starts at Planarcadia, Duomension City, after Trailblaze Mission The Indifference of Those Who Yet Live.

quests.title: Blood of the Lone Wolf
quests.summary: Silver Wolf takes a detective job she could not refuse and drags you into a murder investigation.
quests.start: Starts at Planarcadia, Seafeld TV Tower, after Trailblaze Mission Arcadia Revisited.

quests.title: Floating Grease Chronicles
quests.summary: Charing, who helped gather the Floating Grease Chronicles, sends new messages from Astropolis.
quests.start: Starts at Astropolis, Astropolis Central District, after Adventure Mission The Fools' Outro.

parts.title: Floating Grease Chronicles: The Reason for Poetry
Floating Grease Chronicles: A Page of A Thousand Stars

quests.start: Starts at Astropolis, Lodestar Tower, after Trailblaze Mission Mythological Philosophy and Fair Game.

quests.summary: In Astropolis, working after death is literal; ghost Skott clashes with an old buddy from the employment center.
quests.start: Starts at Astropolis, Lodestar Tower, after Trailblaze Mission Mythological Philosophy and Fair Game.

quests.title: Secrets of a City
quests.summary: Astropolis is full of stories; Mr. Reca has some of its secrets to share.
quests.start: Starts at Astropolis, Astropolis Central District.

quests.summary: The actor known as the Tousled Detective has disappeared, and you set out with Ashveil to find out why.
quests.start: Starts at Astropolis, Astropolis Central District, after Trailblaze Mission Mythological Philosophy and Fair Game.

quests.title: The Metamorphosis
quests.summary: An argument with an Astropolis Sentinel pulls you into a dispute at the Life Sciences Institute.
quests.start: Starts at Astropolis, Life Sciences Institute, after Trailblaze Mission Good Hunting.

quests.title: Searching for You
quests.summary: Himeko calls you back to the Express to talk about the Nameless, starting a search across past worlds.
quests.start: Starts at Astral Express, Parlor Car.

parts.title: Searching for You: Of Snow and Sun
Searching for You: Echoes of Yore

quests.title: You Already Know Me
quests.summary: Rumors that Asta misused station funds spread in an anonymous group chat, and you set out to clear her name.
quests.start: Starts at Herta Space Station, Parlor Car. Requires Trailblaze Level 17, and Trailblaze Mission Not Good With Farewells.

quests.title: Old Foreman's Treasure
quests.summary: Julian sends word that Hook is in trouble, setting off a hunt for an old foreman's buried treasure.
quests.start: Starts at Jarilo-VI, Boulder Town. Requires Trailblaze Level 16, and Trailblaze Mission Lying in Rust.

quests.series: Slices of Life Before the Furnace
quests.title: Origin of Medicine
quests.summary: Oleg asks you to check on Natasha, who is overworked caring for Underworld patients while a 'wonder medicine' spreads.
quests.start: Starts at Jarilo-VI, Boulder Town. Requires Trailblaze Level 20, and Trailblaze Mission Trial of the Equilibrium: Part One.

quests.start: Starts at Jarilo-VI, Administrative District. Requires Trailblaze Level 24, and Adventure Mission Ancestor's Drill Bit.

quests.start: Starts at Jarilo-VI, Administrative District. Requires Companion Mission Only A Child.

quests.start: Starts at The Xianzhou Luofu, Exalting Sanctum. Requires Trailblaze Level 34, and Trailblaze Mission Humming Antlers, Entwined Horns.

quests.start: Starts at The Xianzhou Luofu, Central Starskiff Haven. Requires Trailblaze Level 34, and Trailblaze Mission Humming Antlers, Entwined Horns.

quests.summary: A starskiff crash at Stargazer Navalia brings you and Welt to Helm Master Yukong.
quests.start: Starts at The Xianzhou Luofu, Stargazer Navalia. Requires Trailblaze Mission A Dragon Gallant, Its Ocean Distant.

parts.title: For I Have Touched the Sky

quests.summary: Dan Heng returns to the Luofu to face his past and asks you to meet the Vidyadhara's high elder with him.
quests.start: Starts at The Xianzhou Luofu, Exalting Sanctum. Requires Trailblaze Mission Obsequies Performed, A Long Road Ahead.

quests.summary: Fu Xuan agrees to use the Matrix of Prescience to search March 7th's past for her lost memories.
quests.start: Starts at The Xianzhou Luofu, Divination Commission. Requires Trailblaze Mission Obsequies Performed, A Long Road Ahead.

parts.title: Total Recall: Addendum
parts.note: Adventure Mission follow-up to Total Recall.

quests.summary: An unsigned letter appears in the Parlor Car, leading to a reunion tied to the Luofu's old swordmaster.
quests.start: Starts at Astral Express, Parlor Car. Requires Trailblaze Mission Obsequies Performed, A Long Road Ahead.

quests.summary: Visitors bring the sword Guyun back to the Xianzhou, and Yunli declares it cursed at a glance.
quests.start: Starts at The Xianzhou Luofu, Central Starskiff Haven. Requires Trailblaze Continuance Rogues on the Run.

quests.title: Masquerade Duet
quests.summary: Dr. Edward invites you to the Dreamscape Sales Store to experience a dream Black Swan left for you.
quests.start: Starts at Penacony, Golden Hour. Requires Trailblaze Mission Whodunit.

quests.summary: Arlan wants to thank you properly, but a guest's visit and a hacker turn it into a Simulated Universe mess.
quests.start: Starts at Herta Space Station, Base Zone. Requires Trailblaze Level 21.

quests.title: Letter from a Strange Woman
quests.summary: Kafka messages you saying she is in trouble and needs help. Whether to believe her is up to you.
quests.start: Starts at The Xianzhou Luofu, Divination Commission. Requires Trailblaze Mission A Dragon Gallant, Its Ocean Distant.

quests.title: Night of Universal Hallucinations
quests.summary: Spring cleaning on the Express goes wrong when the train is swallowed by a giant worm and a knight of Beauty appears.
quests.start: Starts at Astral Express, Parlor Car. Requires Trailblaze Mission Silent Galaxy.

quests.summary: The Arbitrator sets you trials to raise your Equilibrium Level, unlocking tougher enemies and better rewards.
quests.start: Part One needs Trailblaze Level 20 and Trailblaze Mission To Rot or to Burn; later trials unlock at Trailblaze Levels 30, 40, 50, 60 and 65.
